# markfmt grammar cases

Each case gives the expected HTML of a corpus example whose meaning
markfmt's grammar changes. A `grammar-differs.txt` file names the case by
its section (design 11.2). The test HTML renderer writes nothing for front
matter.

## commonmark 96

Front matter takes the first three lines.

```````````````````````````````` example
---
Foo
---
Bar
---
Baz
.
<h2>Bar</h2>
<p>Baz</p>
````````````````````````````````

## commonmark 98

The two lines are empty front matter.

```````````````````````````````` example
---
---
.
````````````````````````````````
